data.title: Scrum rules are warned about, never enforced
data.why: kadence also serves teams that do not run Scrum, and a refusal only moves the change somewhere the journal cannot see it. A sprint without a goal, longer than a month, over velocity, or a goal changed mid-sprint is said once, with the command that fixes it.
data.rejected: Refuse sprint start without a goal: blocks every non-Scrum team on day one; Config flag scrum: strict: a second behaviour to keep in step, for a team nobody has interviewed yet
